content.title: Faith leaders discuss current events, impact of religion at national conference in New Haven
content.text: Skip to content STREAMING NOWWatch News 8 Newscasts & Originals by: Ronan Himelrick Posted: Apr 12, 2026 / 07:16 PM EDT Updated: Apr 12, 2026 / 07:16 PM EDT SHARE NEW HAVEN, Conn. (WTNH) — The Yale Divinity School is hosting a national conference in New Haven this week. Hundreds of clergy members and faith leaders are gathering to discuss current events, history and impact of religion on modern America. Yale University to donate $230M to City of New Haven “We have economists, theologians, sociologists, historians, impacted people, people from all over the country, nearly 500 attendees, coming to wrestle with ‘what is the moral analysis of this moment?'” Bishop William J Barber II, the founding director of the Yale Center for Public Theology & Public Policy said. The event continues through Tuesday.
